businesses.name: R.A. Nichols Home Services (R.A. Nichols Plumbing, Heating & Air)

Family-owned and local since 2007 (per the owner's Google post); certified Daikin Comfort Pro dealer. Holds NJ Plumbing License #11691 and NJ HVAC License #19HC00263900 (stated in site footer).

Helmetta is a very small borough; several businesses share an address or use it only as a mailing address, which makes some records ambiguous (notably 28 Main St, claimed by both an auto shop and an auto repair name in batch.json).
Anna Electric's website was not in batch.json but exists (annaelectric.com) and is linked from its Google profile, so it was reviewed.
data_gaps: Eurostyle Home Improvement: Google lists eurostyleimprovements.com but the domain does not resolve (DNS failure), so website content could not be reviewed.
Three Brothers One in Glory Auto Repair: yolasite.com returned a Cloudflare bot check (HTTP 403 via both browser and fetch); content not read, and the check was not bypassed per instructions.

Google profile completeness (owner-verified vs unclaimed, services, attributes) is inferred from the Maps panel. For All-Wayz, the listed website was a godaddysites.com URL that was not opened to confirm redirect behaviour.
